points.description: States the answer TRUE (the statement is true: exec can be used in the parent after fork and before the child terminates).
Justification: states that the parent and child are two entirely separate/different processes (separate process identities/address spaces), so the parent's actions are independent of the child.
Justification: states that the parent can therefore perform any operation it wants, including calling exec, while the child is still running (before it terminates).

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that precisely states both that parent and child are different processes and that the parent is free to do any operation including exec. Without a correct justification the answer gets 0 in total, even if TRUE is stated. Vague statements like 'it is possible' or answers that say FALSE, or claim exec only works in the child, earn nothing on the affected point.
